name: Proper Displayed Subcube
definition: For $\varnothing\ne S\subsetneq X$, the family $2^S$ embedded in $2^X$ by fixing every coordinate of $X\setminus S$ to zero.
parameters: Finite ground set $X$ and a nonempty proper subset $S$.
properties: It is tree-support-extremal but does not attain Littlestone cardinality equality relative to the displayed ground set $X$.
